sampleArticles.title: This dog used to sniff out cold cases for police. Now she’s saving bees.
sampleArticles.description: Maple sniffs bee colonies for bacteria. Her team hopes she can become a blueprint for other dogs to detect diseases amid a staggering year for bee death.

sampleArticles.title: Fewer trash pickups, more potholes: This big city is bracing for a shaky economy
sampleArticles.description: Syracuse, New York, is the latest city to see its budget slashed as leaders nationwide are rattled by Trump’s tariff policies and slowing housing markets.

sampleArticles.title: Police officer killed in shooting near CDC, officials say
sampleArticles.description: Windows were shot on multiple floors of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention buildings in Atlanta, authorities said.
